# Java Reactive Streams Driver - (current)

> Explore resources and tutorials for using the Java Reactive Streams driver to connect, read, write, and optimize data operations with MongoDB applications.

- [Aggregation Framework](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/java/reactive-streams-driver/current/aggregation.md)
- [Builders](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/java/reactive-streams-driver/current/builders.md): Learn how to use builder classes in the MongoDB Java Reactive Streams driver to write more efficient and error-resistant queries.

- [Sorts Builders](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/java/reactive-streams-driver/current/builders/sort.md): Learn how to use the Sorts builder in the MongoDB Java Reactive Streams driver.

- [Authentication Mechanisms](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/java/reactive-streams-driver/current/security/auth.md): Learn how to authenticate with MongoDB by using the Java Reactive Streams driver, including SCRAM, X.509, AWS IAM, OIDC, LDAP, and Kerberos mechanisms.
- [AWS Identity and Access Management](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/java/reactive-streams-driver/current/security/auth/aws-iam.md)
- [Kerberos (GSSAPI) Authentication](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/java/reactive-streams-driver/current/security/auth/kerberos.md): Learn how to authenticate to a Kerberos service by using the Java Reactive Streams driver. See code examples for connection strings and MongoCredentials.
- [LDAP (PLAIN) Authentication](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/java/reactive-streams-driver/current/security/auth/ldap.md): Learn how to use the Java Reactive Streams driver to authenticate to MongoDB by using LDAP. See a connection string and a MongoCredential code example.
- [OIDC (Workload Identity Federation)](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/java/reactive-streams-driver/current/security/auth/oidc.md): Learn how to use OpenID Connect (OIDC) authentication by using the Java Reactive Streams driver and MongoDB from various platforms, including Azure and GCP.
